name: nutrient-daybook
description: Track a day by meals and supplied goals.

interface.longDescription: Track a day by meals and supplied goals. Includes a launch screen, side-panel workspace, editable input controls and real computations: Total foods by meal; Find contributions to one nutrient; Compare recorded totals with goals you supply. Imports and exports its own versioned documents. Uses supplied information; no live lookup or background monitoring.
defaultPrompt: Help me total foods by meal.
Help me find contributions to one nutrient.

prompts: Help me total foods by meal.
Help me find contributions to one nutrient.
Help me compare recorded totals with goals you supply.

positive.description: Open the launch screen without calculating.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the actual launch screen with three distinct workflow cards. No computation or file access.

positive.prompt: Open the Daily Nutrient Ledger workspace beside this chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the editable workspace and labeled illustrative inputs. No computation starts automatically.
